queries_run: CoreWeave CRWV analyst consensus price target October 2026
CoreWeave guidance 2026 revenue capex raise OR cut Q2 2026 results
CoreWeave analyst estimate revision downgrade upgrade 2026

findings.claim: Benzinga 價目頁（收盤日 2026-09-04）：31 位分析師、共識 Buy、平均目標價 $140；21 Buy、2 Strong Buy、7 Hold、1 Sell；Truist 8/24 升目標價至 $165、Goldman 8/21 升至 $139。為 9 月初快照，無 10 月數據。
findings.excerpt: Benzinga's price-target page, showing a close on Sep 4, lists 31 analysts with a consensus rating of Buy, and an average price target of $140.

findings.claim: Q2 2026 財報（約 8/11）上調 FY2026 營收指引至 $12.4B–$13.2B、調整後營業利益 $960M–$1.15B，年底年化營收 run rate $18.5–19.5B；來源為二手摘要，非公司原文。
findings.source: Quartr / MarketBeat / channelchek 等 Q2 2026 財報摘要（經搜尋彙整）
findings.excerpt: Full-year 2026 revenue guidance was raised to $12.4B to $13.2B. Full-year 2026 adjusted operating income guidance was raised to $960M to $1.15B.

findings.claim: 2026 capex 指引由 $31–35B 上調至 $35–39B；Q3 營收指引 $3.45–3.6B（二手來源）。公司表示後續投資可能需額外債務與/或股權融資。
findings.source: CoreWeave Q2 2026 earnings summaries (channelchek / indmoney / quartr)
findings.excerpt: The company raised its full-year 2026 capital expenditure guidance to $35 billion to $39 billion, up from a prior range of $31 billion to $35 billion.

findings.claim: Q2 營收 $2.58B（年增 112%）略高於共識 $2.56B；淨損 $626M，利息費用 $640M。
findings.excerpt: One source reports revenue of $2.58 billion, up 112% year over year, edging past the $2.56 billion analyst consensus.

findings.claim: Q1 後（2026-05-08）FY2026 營收指引維持 $12–13B、capex 區間下緣上調至 $31B（零組件漲價）；Q2 營收指引中點低於當時共識 $2.69B。7 月 Jefferies Buy、Barclays Equal Weight、Mizuho Neutral、Macquarie Outperform 皆重申無評等變動；7 月後未見券商評等變動。
findings.excerpt: The company now projects capex between $31 billion and $35 billion, compared with its prior outlook range of $30 billion to $35 billion.

note: 僅 3 次搜尋。無 2026-10 共識數據；目標價分布高低值僅有未註明日期的聚合頁（MarketBeat 高 $200／低 $32、AlphaSpread $41–246），未採用。目標價 vs 現價請引 numbers.price_at_dd。
